### Father to the Fatherless
Author: Ashley Moore
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/father-to-the-fatherless-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Psalm 68:5
Points:
- Painful or absent relationships with earthly fathers often distort how people perceive God.
- Scripture reveals God as a trustworthy Father who cares deeply for the vulnerable and abandoned.
- Believers are fully adopted into God's family through faith in Jesus Christ.
- Turning to God intimately as Father helps heal emotional wounds and builds lasting spiritual security.

### An Unbreakable Home: What God Says to the Fatherless
Author: Mike Schumann
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/an-unbreakable-home
Passage: Psalm 68:5
Points:
- Growing up without an earthly father can produce persistent feelings of insecurity and grief.
- Psalm 68:5 reveals that God is not merely a temporary substitute, but a devoted Father to the fatherless.
- The Lord provides attentive care, infallible guidance, and unending strength to His children.
- Through Christ, those who lack earthly paternal protection receive an enduring, unbreakable home.

### My Gaze on Praise
Author: Dawn Mast
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement-cafe/my-gaze-on-praise-encouragement-caf-august-1-2018.html
Passage: Psalm 68:19
Points:
- God attentively observes our daily lives and provides for our needs even before we pray.
- Human nature often defaults to complaining rather than acknowledging God's goodness.
- Believers are called to praise God not only for His interventions, but for who He is.
- Meditating on God's gifts and the Psalms redirects the heart toward the God who bears our daily burdens.
